name: ra9-atlas-prototype
description: Static, evidence-labeled map prototypes (PoC2-PoC4). No runtime dependencies.

scripts.validate: npm run check:generated && npm run validate:inventory && node prototype/validate-map-data.js && node prototype/validate-hostage-data.js && node prototype/validate-atlas-data.js && npm run validate:packet
scripts.validate:packet: node prototype/validate-chapter-packet.js packets/hostage.packet.json && node prototype/validate-chapter-packet.js packets/a-new-home.packet.json && node prototype/validate-chapter-packet.js packets/shades-of-color.packet.json
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:build && npm run test:inventory && npm run test:contract && npm run test:unit && npm run test:map && npm run test:stable-zoom && npm run test:layout && npm run test:packet && npm run test:shades && npm run test:shades-runtime && npm run test:browser
